Natural Earth map data

Public domain. Upstream: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
Terms of use: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

The decorative vector globe uses an offline orthographic derivation of
Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 country geometry already bundled with FoxHole Guard.
Shared administrative boundaries are removed; only simplified visible
coastline paths are included in FoxHole VPN. No source GeoJSON or map SDK
is included. This decorative globe is not a geographic or political map.
